description: El Salvador's 2007 Population and Housing Census is online as a REDATAM database on the statistics office server, built by the former DIGESTYC with UNFPA and ECLAC-CELADE. Dwelling records carry dwelling type and the materials of outer walls, roof and floor. Household records give the type of sanitation and whether it is shared, how grey water is disposed of, where the water comes from and on how many days a week it arrives, cooking fuel, type of lighting, refuse disposal and household equipment such as fixed and mobile telephones and computers. The geography nests department, municipality, canton and census segment, so tables can go below municipal level. Format and access: free online frequencies, cross tabulations, area lists and predefined indicators, a downloadable REDATAM dictionary, the questionnaire, the enumerator manual and the final results report. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: data are from 2007 and have been superseded by the 2024 census, whose results are published through the central bank geoportal; the pages use an older character encoding. Simulation uses: the days-per-week water supply variable is a direct measure of intermittent supply, and segment level roof and wall materials support earthquake and storm exposure models. Related records: the 2024 census dwelling indicators table and the ECLAC REDATAM hub.
